terms.grammar: noun (from the participle, with terra understood)
evidence: Nep. Them. 3.2: terra continēns (Lewis & Short s.v. contineō)
terms.comment: A participle used as a noun, with terra understood: in continentī, on the mainland. Lewis & Short: the noun is far more frequent than terra continēns.
terms.gloss: the mainland, a continent (as opposed to an island)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 343.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
